## Why it happens

Your user's roles do not include this operation on this item. For example, a customer user tried to change a device, or a tenant administrator opened a system setting.

## Fix it

Ask an administrator to give your user group a role that allows it, or sign in as a user who has it. See [Roles and permissions](/docs/administration/roles/).

## Check that it worked

The action works after the administrator changes the role. Sign out and in again if it does not.
